description.narrative: The project aims to improve and maintain a 244 km concession connecting Buga and Buenaventura, enhancing capacity, connectivity, and safety, and incorporating technology solutions. This is expected to reduce congestion and improve travel time by 20%. BLB also enhances integration by improving key sections of the corridor, crucial for Colombia's trade and logistics, as Buenaventura handles 44% of the country's trade, including 90% of cargo from Asia. Improving road infrastructure is vital for reducing Colombia's high logistics costs, which are more than double those in the OECD. Environmentally, the project will reduce the transport sector's carbon footprint by lowering GHG emissions due to reduced travel time for heavy vehicles.

The proposed investment entails an A-Loan of up to US$200 million -Loan in COP-linked equivalent for the financing of the Buga - Loboguerrero - Buenaventura concession (BLB or the Project). The Project is a brownfield toll road awarded in 2022 by the Colombias National Infrastructure Agency (ANI) with construction starting in August 2024. The concession scope includes design, construction, rehabilitation, expansion, and operation and maintenance (O&M) activities for up to 29 years. BLB has a length of 244km. Construction activities include the rehabilitation and improvement of 154 km, the addition of two short tunnels totaling 1.4 km, stabilizing critical slopes, enhancing 33.7 km of road, converting 35 km of single carriageway to dual, rehabilitating the last 24 km access road through Buenaventura, and replacing electromechanical equipment in 17 tunnels with a combined length of 9.3 km.
